layers.authority: Chinese authorities, through a specialist travel agent in China
layers.process: Permit needed for Tibet, organised tour only. Authorities sometimes stop issuing permits without notice or restrict Tibetan Autonomous Prefectures in neighbouring provinces. Smartraveller (28 September 2026) says reconsider travel to Gyirong County after August flooding.

laws.rule: You need a permit to enter Tibet and must travel on an organised tour arranged through a specialist travel agent in China; permits can be suspended without notice. Don't photograph security forces, ask before photographing in monasteries, and don't carry letters or packages for Tibetans.

sites.name: Mt Kailash and Lake Manasarovar
sites.what: Sacred mountain and lake in western Tibet. India's MEA-run yatra (20 batches of 50 via Lipulekh and Nathu La in 2026) is for Indian pilgrims; Australians go through the Tibet permit and organised-tour route.

access.permits: Tibet Travel Permit through a China travel agent, organised tour only (see cn/tibet zone requirements); further area permits not yet checked

lore.text: Popular lore calls Kailash Mt Meru, the axis of the world, and a gateway to Shambhala.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source
